metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Astro - agent workflow and platform integrations

plugins.name: agent-toast
plugins.description: Claude Stop-hook desktop notification integration for Windows/WSL, macOS, and Linux. ThreatLocker-safe Windows path; configurable name, session label, icon, and beep.

plugins.name: claude-multi-agent-flow
plugins.description: Repository story flow across two agents: Claude Code implements, Codex CLI reviews read-only, and a human owns PR and merge gates. Supports local or remote specs, configurable base branches, and project-owned verification.

plugins.name: project-setup
plugins.description: Classify, plan, reconcile, and bootstrap a software product repository: project profile, product plan, conditional design spec, epic backlog, engineering guide, agent instructions, story templates, and a deterministic verification gate. Greenfield or existing repository.

plugins.name: close-story-worktree
plugins.description: Verify that a story pull request was merged, then safely remove its clean local worktree and delete the merged local branch. Refuses to act before the human merge gate.

plugins.name: disciplined-coding
plugins.description: Implement, fix, refactor, or review code with explicit assumptions, minimal complexity, tightly scoped diffs, and verifiable success criteria. Rigor is calibrated to risk.
